aggregates.timings_note: Timing metrics are per-trial and clock-labelled; fake-clock values are simulated and do not populate measured fields. No cross-trial latency average is presented as a live-call promise.

steps: every Unicode punctuation character (general category P*) becomes a space
whitespace collapsed to single spaces and trimmed

wer.empty_reference: WER is null; substitution/deletion/insertion counts are preserved
wer.alignment: deterministic Levenshtein; cost ties prefer match, then substitution, then deletion, then insertion
wer.reports: per-trial S/D/I plus micro-aggregate errors/reference count

local_agreement_2.comparison: NFC/casefolded whitespace words with Unicode punctuation removed; accents and ñ preserved
local_agreement_2.stability: words in the common prefix of two consecutive hypotheses; stable history is append-only
local_agreement_2.conflicts: later conflicting hypotheses and final corrections are explicit events; they never rewrite confirmed stable history
local_agreement_2.units: runner word-level LA-2; native committed text is separate

native_committed_text.comparison: raw whitespace-canonicalized character prefix; native policy units are not assumed to equal runner words
native_committed_text.finalization: final_text is authoritative even when committed history differs

timings.replay_start: t0 for all replay-relative fields; defined one sample period before the first fixture sample becomes available (sample i arrives at t0+(i+1)/sample_rate). first_partial_ms/first_stable_ms are conservatively high by 1/sample_rate (0.0625 ms at 16 kHz); the convention is retained for stability
timings.first_partial_ms: first nonempty partial result arrival (call return) relative to replay start t0
timings.first_stable_ms: first nonempty stable/committed result arrival relative to replay start t0
timings.final_after_audio_end_ms: final call return minus fixture audio-end arrival
timings.call_wall_ms: runner monotonic elapsed around an engine call; includes validation/transport/native compute, not pure GPU decode time
timings.queue_lag_ms: call start minus the selected scheduled tick/segment arrival
timings.backlog_samples: audio available at call start beyond the frozen prefix
timings.backlog_samples_after: audio available after the call beyond the frozen prefix
timings.coalesced_ticks: scheduled partial/feed ticks superseded after a slow call
timings.native_decode_ms: nullable native decode component; zero, negative, nonfinite and absent values mean unknown and are never zero-filled
timings.fake_clock: fake-clock values populate simulated fields only; measured stays null

aggregation.micro: sum of S/D/I over sum of reference tokens; empty references count separately
aggregation.macro: mean of per-trial WER ratios over trials with a nonempty reference; context only

unsupported.word_end_latency: unsupported: no independent gold word timings exist; native token end_ms values are model hypotheses, not verified ground truth, so word-end/display latency is not reported
unsupported.rolling_window: long-call rollover/rolling windows are not implemented; fixtures above the configured max window are rejected rather than truncated
unsupported.endpoint_boundaries: fixture segment boundaries are oracle endpoints, not tested VAD

limitations: Tiny-fixture feasibility evidence only; not a model leaderboard and not an acceptance threshold.
Oracle fixture segment boundaries are not a tested VAD.
No independent gold word timings exist: word-end/display latency is unsupported/null, never inferred from model token timestamps.
call_wall_ms includes validation/transport/native compute; it is not pure GPU decode time. Native decode_ms is nullable; zero, negative and nonfinite values are unknown and never zero-filled.

Default fixtures mix natural FLEURS material with derived/synthetic assemblies (repeated natural audio and EN→ES concatenation). Endpoint decode splits derived assemblies at oracle segment boundaries and does not exercise within-call or mid-sentence language switching; separate natural-versus-derived tables when interpreting results.
Rolling/long-call windows are unsupported: fixtures above the configured max window are rejected rather than silently truncated.
Fake-clock trials populate simulated timing fields only and are not live-call evidence.
Firefox/capture, live calls and interview participation are outside this runner.
Endpoint/hybrid batch decoding is labelled as documented offline R=13 context; native streaming R=3 lookahead is not measured by this arm.
